description: Phase 5 fair-baseline control for claim C3 (Phase 5 Comparison Plan 2026-11-09T11:00+01:00): GCN with one-hot node degree, the quantum model's architecture and 3,906 parameters, four seeds, the paper's 200 epochs at constant lr 1e-3.
split: test (10% of the 800 generated graphs, split seed 1729)
checkpoint_rule: model with the highest validation accuracy over the 200 epochs, evaluated once on the test split
aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over the four seeds
tie_rule: no winner unless the margin exceeds twice the larger seed standard deviation and an exact McNemar test on the pooled test predictions gives p < 0.05
